kind: scientific skill pack with executable helpers

runtime.execution: Host agent discovers SKILL.md; selected helper scripts are normal Python processes. Autoskill explicitly composes local observation, embedding and LLM services.
runtime.service_boundary: Consumes host execution/skills, public databases and user-managed screenpipe/LLM endpoints; supplies no coding-agent turn loop.

summary: 181 scientific skills, references, scripts and a workflow-derived skill drafting primitive

inspection.scope: plugin metadata, database-lookup contract, autoskill discovery/provider/synthesis/staging/promotion and deterministic fake-service tests; representative DICOM UID validation
inspection.limits: Catalog breadth inventoried, not every helper manually traced. Host dispatch/compaction/audit enforcement are outside pack.

actions.name: SKILL.md frontmatter / load_skill_descriptions(skills_dir)
actions.surface: Host skill catalog and autoskill Python discovery
actions.output: Selected skill guidance or list used for cosine similarity
actions.lifecycle: On file read/load; no host reload scheduling contract
actions.authority: Host loader and autoskill client filesystem authority

actions.name: database-lookup retrieval contract
actions.input: Named database, entity IDs, filters, completeness/count/pagination requirements
actions.output: Bounded API results plus endpoints/params/access date/count reconciliation
actions.lifecycle: External API request/response; no persistent interpreter or standing app DB
actions.authority: Read/Bash frontmatter; authored confirmation thresholds; host enforces authority

actions.name: autoskill.run(config, start_time, end_time, ...)
actions.input: Screenpipe client/token, time window, embedding/LLM backend and skills/output directories
actions.output: Timestamped plan/report and staged new-skills/composition-recipes folders
actions.lifecycle: On-demand synchronous run; dry-run stops after clustering; no resident auto loop
actions.authority: User-triggered in skill contract; calls separately managed services

actions.name: autoskill.synthesize(cluster, top_k_skills, backend)
actions.output: reuse target or compose/novel valid-name nonempty SKILL.md draft
actions.lifecycle: One selected backend call per cluster, response schema validation
actions.authority: Backend credential/endpoint selected by invoking client

actions.name: autoskill.promote(proposed_path, skills_dir, name)
actions.input: Proposal directory, target catalog and name
actions.output: Moved skill folder; existing target rejected
actions.lifecycle: Filesystem promotion; no quality eval, rollback or in-flight host redefinition
actions.authority: Explicit CLI/client invocation; host activation unspecified

actions.name: uid_mapping_validator.validate_mapping(...)
actions.input: Bounded map, optional key/scope and2.25 requirement
actions.lifecycle: One call, no network; validates map consistency, not dataset completeness

evidence.claim: Plugin metadata identifies scientific skill pack.
Frontmatter discovery and bounded public database retrieval/provenance contract, not a resident DB.
Directory frontmatter description discovery and cosine top-k matching.
Fetch/redact/segment/cluster/match/synthesize writes proposals and report; dry-run avoids synthesis.
LLM output validates verdict/name/nonempty body, not skill behavior.
Promotion moves a staged folder, refuses existing target; no evaluation/host activation mechanism.
Single-request Claude/Foundry and OpenAI-compatible local LLM adapters; selection is not collaboration.
User-triggered observation/draft workflow, local screenpipe, redacted summaries and opt-in remote backend.
Bounded UID mapping checks syntax, uniqueness, standard UID protection and optional keyed derivation; aggregate result explicitly not deidentification proof.
Offline fake services check specific cluster/report and staged draft outcomes; do not test improvement effectiveness.
Literal folder move/content preservation/missing proposal oracles.

tests.oracle: Deterministic fake OCR/LLM/embedding check known surviving patterns and exact staged draft paths. Does not establish real-world detection or generated skill quality.
Literal path/content/presence and explicit failure checks; no host activation or effectiveness oracle.

strengths: Concrete proposal pipeline with injectable dependencies and offline literal oracles.
Scientific helpers can expose aggregate invariant failures rather than plausible prose.
limits: Skill discovery does not imply host execution/reload/authority enforcement.
Promotion is a file move; no comparative evaluation of proposed skills or harness self-refit.
arconaut_questions: Can workflow-derived proposal machinery feed model-governed autodroit experiments with independent performance oracles?
How should scientific helper provenance be captured at original request/response scope while consumer services remain independent?
